headline: cyzhao climbs 272 places into ARC-2 top 100

sections.text: cyzhao climbed from 364th to 92nd on the ARC-AGI-2 public board, reaching 33.89 after a 2.08-point gain.
The move puts cyzhao among the board’s top 100 teams.
